deploy-bot: Starting hotfix rollout: tag=v1.7.3-hotfix commit=8b2f4c env=prod regions=[us-west-2,eu-west-1] mode=canary canary=10% change-window=2026-03-20T22:00Z-23:00Z initiator=@maya
maya: Kicking off smoke checks now — watching 5xx and latency for first 15m. I’ll ping ops if anything spikes.
kevin: Noted. Holding DB migrations for this window. Are we pinning model-serving to v1.7.3 for the rippler service?
maya: Yes — pinning inference runtime for rippler-service to v1.7.3-hotfix. Other services remain on latest. Rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic pause on errors.
liam: Quick prod-canary checklist: health endpoints return 200, no >0.5% 5xx, kv cache memory stable. If error rate >0.5% during canary -> rollback.
deploy-bot: Deploy started to us-west-2 canary (10%) — job_id=548217. Release notes headline: fix tokenization crash on very-long prompts; reduce KV-cache OOMs.
maya: Seeing initial canary logs, latency +3ms — acceptable. No 5xx so far.
ops-oncall: Dashboards configured, alerts mirrored to #incidents. I’ll escalate on the first anomaly.
kevin: Unless anything shows up, approve promote to 50% in ~12m.
maya: Promote in 10. promoting now.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% complete in us-west-2. Starting eu-west-1 canary at 10% (job_id=548318).
liam: eu-west canary looks clean. Small p99 spike but within SLO and no error rate increase.
maya: Promoting eu-west to 100% and finishing us-west to 100% in ~5m.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: production at 100% for tag v1.7.3-hotfix commit=8b2f4c. All canaries passed. Post-deploy checks green. Release notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v1.7.3-hotfix
kevin: Thanks — pinning infra-proxy routing rule to this tag for the next 48h to avoid auto-swap.
maya: Will open a follow-up PR documenting rollback thresholds and the canary metrics we observed. :shipit:
